item.title: Israeli lawmakers set up a special tribunal and allow for death penalty for Hamas-led 2023 attackers
item.description: Israeli lawmakers have approved a bill setting up a special tribunal that would try and have the authority to sentence to death Palestinians convicted of taking part in the 2023 Hamas-led attack that triggered the war in Gaza

item.title: Russia, Ukraine trade blame for continued fighting as US-brokered ceasefire nears end
item.description: Moscow and Kyiv have accused each other of disregarding U.S. President Donald Trump’s request to stop their attacks

item.title: UK sanctions 9 people for alleged Iran-linked 'hostile activity'
item.description: The British government has sanctioned nine people and three organizations accused of hostile activities for Iran

item.title: ICC unseals arrest warrant for a prominent Philippine senator over drug war killings under Duterte
item.description: The International Criminal Court has unsealed an arrest warrant for a prominent Philippine senator linked to the deadly “war on drugs” overseen by ex-President Rodrigo Duterte, which allegedly involved the extrajudicial killings of suspects

item.title: A South Korean startup captures workers' techniques to develop AI brains for robots
item.description: Workers at a five-star hotel fold napkins and wipe silverware with body cameras recording their every move

item.title: How Keir Starmer could be replaced as UK prime minister after Labour suffers local election drubbing
item.description: U.K. Prime Minister Keir Starmer is facing a potential battle to remain in office after his Labour Party suffered a calamitous set of election results last week
